package ownerbranch

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"

	"example.test/auth"
	"example.test/httperr"
)

type Handlers struct{}

func ownerFigures() []int { return []int{1} }
func teamFigures() []int  { return []int{2} }

func (h Handlers) GetProgress(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.URL.Query().Get("scope") == "owner" {
		if err := auth.Require(r.Context()); err != nil {
			httperr.Write(w, r, err)
			return
		}
		httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, ownerFigures())
		return
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, teamFigures())
}

func (h Handlers) GetProgressBySwitch(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	switch r.URL.Query().Get("scope") {
	case "owner":
		if err := auth.Require(r.Context()); err != nil {
			httperr.Write(w, r, err)
			return
		}
	case "team":
		break
	default:
		auth.Require(r.Context())
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, teamFigures())
}

// An iteration that skips ahead before the check leaves the rows unchecked.
func (h Handlers) GetEachRowSkippingOne(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var out []int
	for _, row := range teamFigures() {
		if row == 2 {
			continue
		}
		if err := auth.Require(r.Context()); err != nil {
			httperr.Write(w, r, err)
			return
		}
		out = append(out, row)
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}

// A loop may run no time, so a check inside it covers nothing after it.
func (h Handlers) GetEachRowCheckingInside(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	for range teamFigures() {
		auth.Require(r.Context())
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, teamFigures())
}

// A figure-free call is not a check for the figure made after it.
func (h Handlers) GetAfterTheCatalog(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	names := auth.Catalog()
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string][]int{names[0]: teamFigures()})
}

// A new error beside a figure does not make the return a refusal.
func teamFigureBesideARefusal(ctx context.Context) ([]int, error) {
	return teamFigures(), fmt.Errorf("the team is too small")
}

func (h Handlers) GetAFigureBesideARefusal(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	out, err := teamFigureBesideARefusal(r.Context())
	if err != nil {
		httperr.Write(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}
